title: Design System: alex is listening to

body.purpose: All metadata, labels, controls, and lists.

motion.name: color-change
motion.purpose: Quiet state and background color changes only.

components.name: Recommendation Button
components.css: .ds-button { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 2px solid #181512; border-radius: 0; background: #f6f0db; color: #181512; font: 400 1rem/1.5 'Comic Sans MS', 'Comic Sans', cursive; } .ds-button:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0000ee; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button:active { background: #181512; color: #f6f0db; } .ds-button:disabled { opacity: .6; }

components.name: Recommendation Input
components.description: A visibly labeled square text field.
components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="ds-input">send me something</label><input class="ds-input" id="ds-input" type="text">
components.css: .ds-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; color: #181512; font: 400 1rem/1.5 'Comic Sans MS', 'Comic Sans', cursive; } .ds-input { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px; border: 2px solid #181512; border-radius: 0; background: #f6f0db; color: #181512; font: 400 1rem/1.5 'Comic Sans MS', 'Comic Sans', cursive; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0000ee; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: A personal homepage from the early web kept useful through careful modern engineering. The composition is direct, flat, and a little awkward on purpose. Dynamic album artwork and the color sampled from it provide all the visual spectacle the page needs.
keyCharacteristics: Album art as content and atmosphere
Dense, legible lists instead of cards
Quiet responsive behavior with no decorative motion

rules.name: The Album Owns the Hero Rule
rules.body: The current cover may set the first viewport background. Every other section remains stable and readable.

rules.name: The One Font Rule
rules.body: Comic Sans is identity, not decoration. Do not introduce a tasteful second family.

rules.name: The Flat Page Rule
rules.body: If an element looks lifted off the page, flatten it.

dos: Do preserve Comic Sans, default-browser link conventions, hard edges, and slightly awkward directness.
Do use real album art and Last.fm data.
Do keep controls keyboard accessible with 44px touch targets.
Do keep the first viewport focused on the current track.
donts: Don't use modern SaaS landing pages or portfolio templates as references.
Don't use glassmorphism, gradients, rounded card grids, startup copy, or cinematic scroll effects.
Don't add decorative cards, badges, pills, shadows, or icon bubbles.
Don't smooth away the Web 1.0 personality.
